description: The MfE Data Service is the online data service of New Zealand's Ministry for the Environment, which has released open government data about the environment since 2009. The information page read on 2026-09-28 (last updated 24 April 2024) says the service gives free web access to the environmental datasets the ministry publishes on air, atmosphere, climate, fresh water, land and marine topics, with an application programming interface for automated access by other services, that datasets are added progressively, and that each dataset carries its own licence defining attribution and permitted use, since data are uploaded with the permission of their providers; related pages cover the New Zealand land use map, satellite data search and forest, soil and LiDAR data. Coverage is national. Access is free; licences are per dataset. Caveats: the service itself and its dataset list were not opened on the day, and many layers are environmental indicators, not infrastructure. It supports land use, freshwater and climate context for hazard exposure and adaptation studies of New Zealand infrastructure. Related record: data-norwegian-environment-agency-data-and-products is a comparable national environmental data service.
